entry_gate: G7 completion report, audit and snapshot saved before any G8 asset or inference stage
rationale: Check whether frozen-enhancement WER tradeoffs depend on autoregressive Whisper. Independent CTC greedy decoding supplies a second task proxy, not a substitute for human phoneme judgments.
documented_license: MIT, originally published and redistributed under same license; verified official page and installed bundle docstring
documented_training_data: LibriSpeech train-clean-100/train-clean-360/train-other-500,960h pretrain and ASR fine-tuning. Official description excludes dev-clean; not an independent audit of original training data.
paper_title: wav2vec 2.0: A Framework for Self-Supervised Learning of Speech Representations
safe_loading: Use official bundle get_model, existing local cached file only after bounded download and locally pinned SHA; dl_kwargs weights_only=True, map_location=cpu. No unrestricted external pickle or remote code.
integrity_policy: Official HTTPS transport plus record byte length/ETag and calculate local SHA256 for all subsequent checks. Do not label local hash as independently published publisher checksum.
decoding: batch1, FP32 eval, official raw16k waveform path with bundle normalize_waveform=False, greedy argmax then collapse consecutive repeats then remove blank0 and replace | with spaces, no external LM/prompt/resampling/peak normalization
capacity_probe: 1/3s and actual fixed clean source; report finite outputs/label dimensions/peak memory/time. No performance-based recognizer selection.
scope_if_activated: Rescore exact saved G5 and G7 outputs/references with same word normalizer; all systems/seeds, no SE training/checkpoint selection. Hash audio cache, save clean-reference floor, S/D/I and directional paired effects under each ASR. Do not compare absolute WER as if metrics were same backend.
limitations: Two recognizers can share biases; CTC still has learned language regularities. Sign agreement strengthens conditional task evidence, not acoustic-deletion proof. Do not reproduce paper headline WER by citation.
